opportunities.name: Lantern AP burst
opportunities.objective: Test lantern ap burst against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Empower has 0.6 AP, Grandmaster's active 1.0 AP[source modifier], and Counter Strike 0.7 AP plus max-health magic damage. Lich Bane adds an independent magic attack after W; Rocketbelt helps connect E without requiring sustained AD attacks.
opportunities.requiredState: Dodge incoming attacks before releasing E and connect the R active.
opportunities.failure: Burst failure leaves a fragile melee champion without conventional AD defenses.
opportunities.test: Compare E after zero and five dodges, then W-R burst.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Leap Strike remains physical with an AD term; AP does not strengthen that documented component.

opportunities.name: Grandmaster attack battery
opportunities.objective: Test grandmaster attack battery against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Grandmaster's Might makes the magic passive every second attack while its active defense lasts eight seconds; Nashor and Rageblade complement normal attacks, while Terminus penetrates mixed damage. Riftmaker supports staying after Counter Strike ends, but losing bonus AD also reduces R resistance terms.
opportunities.requiredState: Hit a champion with R and attack continuously during its eight seconds.
opportunities.failure: CC or disengage wastes the activated two-hit cadence.
opportunities.test: Count genuine R passive procs and total attacks across the active duration.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Rageblade phantom-hit advancement of Jax's counter is a test, not a guaranteed double proc.

ruledOut.reason: Leap Strike remains physical with an AD term; AP does not strengthen that documented component.

unknowns: Controlled current-patch proc testing remains necessary; source helper/statFormula expressions are evidence, not confirmed runtime behavior.

builds.name: Lantern AP burst
builds.summary: Test lantern ap burst against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test lantern ap burst against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Empower has 0.6 AP, Grandmaster's active 1.0 AP[source modifier], and Counter Strike 0.7 AP plus max-health magic damage. Lich Bane adds an independent magic attack after W; Rocketbelt helps connect E without requiring sustained AD attacks.
testPlan: Required state: Dodge incoming attacks before releasing E and connect the R active.
Compare E after zero and five dodges, then W-R burst.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Burst failure leaves a fragile melee champion without conventional AD defenses.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Leap Strike remains physical with an AD term; AP does not strengthen that documented component.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Hextech Rocketbelt, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next Attack or Leap Strike to deal an additional [50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage.

Passive: Every third Attack within [2.5] seconds deals an additional [75 / 130 / 185 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage.

Active: Jax slams his lantern down, dealing [100 / 175 / 250 + (1) × AP[statFormula=2]] magic damage to nearby enemies. If he hits a champion he gains [45 / 60 / 75 + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] Armor and [(45 / 60 / 75 + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.6)] Magic Resist plus [20 / 25 / 30 + (0.1) × AD[statFormula=2]] Armor and [(20 / 25 / 30 + (0.1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.6)] Magic Resist per additional champion hit for [8] seconds. During this time every second Attack deals additional magic damage instead of every third.

Jax enters a defensive stance for up to [2] seconds, dodging incoming Attacks and taking [25]% less damage from area of effect Abilities. After [2] seconds or Recasting, Jax deals [40 / 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 + (0.7) × AP[statFormula=2]] + [4]% max Health magic damage and Stuns nearby enemies for [1] second. 

The damage is increased by [20]% per Attack dodged, up to a maximum of [(40 / 70 / 100 / 130 / 160 + (0.7) × AP[statFormula=2]) × (2)] + [(4) × (2)]% max Health.
